title: Orders API: follow the cursor, survive the 5xx

ticket.subject: Nightly orders load dies on a 503 every night
body: The shop's orders API pages with a cursor (`next_cursor`, see API.md), and its gateway is flaky: it answers
503 or 502 now and then. Our load crashes on the first one and `bronze.api_orders` stays half full.
Please make `ingest.py` follow the cursor until the end and **retry** a request that failed with a 5xx
(a short backoff is fine), so every order lands in `bronze.api_orders`, once each.
Don't retry a 4xx: that is our bug, not theirs.

acceptance.text: bronze.api_orders holds every order once, with the right amounts.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS ids, round(sum(amount), 2) AS total FROM bronze.api_orders
checks.fail: The table does not hold every order exactly once.

acceptance.text: The last run met the gateway's 5xx answers, retried them, and followed the cursor to the end.

checks.fail: Your last run did not finish cleanly.
The request log does not show every failed page retried until the end.

hints: Loop while `next_cursor` is not null, passing it back as `cursor`. The first request has no cursor.
Wrap one request in a small function: try up to 4 times, sleep a little between attempts (0.2 s, 0.4 s…), retry only when `status_code >= 500`.
Collect all the orders, then write them once. `bronze.merge("api_orders", rows, key="order_id")` keeps a rerun from duplicating anything.
